text:
maya: FYI ran the overnight batch on lorax-13b q4->q5 quant profile. Saw a regression in p95 latency and a weird "token drift" in some code completions.
rob: ugh. can you paste an example of the drift? short snippet ok
maya: here's a minimal example from the eval harness:

maya: ```
Input: "def sanitize(user_input):\n    # remove newlines\n    return user_input.replace('\n', ' ')
Model output (expected): "def sanitize(user_input):\n    # remove newlines\n    return user_input.replace('\n', ' ')
Model output (observed): "def sanitize(user_input):\n    # remove newlines\n    return user_input.replace('\n', ' '\n# note: memory leak\n# note: memory leak\n"```

sandeep: that's the repetition+context corruption pattern we've seen before with kv-cache packing issues after quant changes
lia: can you share the exact quant config used (bits, groups, zero-point?)
maya: qtype=q4_0, group=128, per_channel=true. conversion used our new fused quant path (opt-fused-quant-2026)
rob: did throughput change too or just latency p95? numbers?
maya: avg token/s similar, but p95 went from 180ms -> 420ms on same worker under same load (small spike at 1-2qps per shard)
qa: repro steps attached in the eval run: pipeline id rwd-eval-2026-04-12-07
infra-bot: deploy-hook: rolled new quant kernel to canary pool at 2026-04-12T07:05Z
rob: could be kernel fallback thrashing or slower memcopy for grouped quant tables
sandeep: also check KV cache alignment — group=128 can shift offsets. If the runtime miscomputes offsets you can end up reading old tokens into the attention key/vals
lia: @sandeep is there a small validation we can run locally against the runtime to confirm offset calc? maybe a unit test that writes a synthetic KV with marker tokens
sandeep: yes, I'll push a quick unit that writes identifiable markers, then run the fused-quant path and compare raw KV bytes
maya: also saw a trace where memcpy accounted for 60% of the extra time. attaching stack snippet:

maya: ```
# trace snippet
gpu memcpy H2D 0.8ms -> quant-decode 3.5ms -> kv-insert 0.2ms
# repeated across tokens
```

rob: can you dump one failing request trace id + model shard id? I'll look at kernel selection logs
maya: trace id rwd-trace-7a9f, shard s-12. Logs uploaded to /mnt/ci/traces/rwd-trace-7a9f.log
lia: temporary mitigation: can we revert to the q4_0 non-fused path for canary? reduces throughput cost but buys stability
infra-bot: rollback initiated for canary pool at 2026-04-12T08:03Z
maya: rollback confirmed, p95 back to ~190ms on canary after 15m
sandeep: ok urgent plan: (1) sandeep adds KV offset unit test + reproduction (2) rob instruments kernel selection/memcopy metrics (3) lia runs quant profile sweep group=64/128/256 to see sensitivity (4) maya runs targeted eval suite over next 6h and posts results
rob: agree. i'll also diff the fused quant binary to the previous build to verify a non-deterministic codegen didn't slip in
lia: I'll add a dashboard chart for memcpy time proportion per model + quant profile
maya: thanks all. marking as P0 for this model until we get root cause. will update thread with repro artifacts
qa: archiving the failing examples to bug rwd-ml-598
maya: quick note: if anyone spots similar patterns for other models (zephyr/aurora) ping this thread
sandeep: starting work now, will ping when KV test PR is up
rob: ping if you want pair-debug on the kernel diffs
